mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for deck board replacement in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether a permit is required for deck board replacement in the East Bay area, including Berkeley, Oakland, and Albany, depends on the extent of the work. Minor, like-for-like board replacement typically does not require a permit. However, if the project involves altering the deck's footprint, structural changes, or significant repairs to the support system, a permit may be necessary. It's always best to check with your local building department.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits for deck board replacement depend on the scope of work. Minor replacement usually doesn't need one; structural changes often do. Check with your local building department.
